thread:
deploy-bot: publish halted for redwood/backend:staging-20260320
Reason: provenance check failed on manifest list for linux/arm64. ECR returned: layer checksum mismatch, attestation rejected.

alia.dev: seeing 502s on arm64 canary nodes, thanks for the heads up.

ben.eng: logs from the push side? I saw one partial push earlier that timed out.

deploy-bot: cosign verify output:
```
Verified OK: redwood/backend@sha256:5f3a...
WARNING: manifest list platform entry linux/arm64 -> layer sha256:deadbeef differs from pushed layer sha256:cafebabe
Attestation status: REJECTED (platform checksum mismatch)
```

carla-release: ugh. two options: 1) republish a corrected multiarch manifest and attestation (preferred), or 2) pin canary and staging to previous digest and proceed with x86-only canary until fix. which is faster?

dave-sre: republish may require un-quarantine of the artifact and a fresh cosign sign with KMS. If the KMS annotation is the root cause, we can clear the quarantine flag and re-sign, but that'll need infra intervention. Pinning is fastest to restore traffic.

emily-rm: we need a clear rollback/retag note in the release notes and a short change window. low traffic window tonight ~02:30 UTC? who's oncall to validate rollback?

ben.eng: I can prepare a retag script to pin to the last-good digest (sha256:9a1b...). snippet: 
```
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name backend --image-ids imageTag=staging-20260319 --query 'images[0].imageManifest' > manifest.json
aws ecr put-image --repository-name backend --image-tag staging-20260320-pin --image-manifest file://manifest.json
```
But if the attestation/metadata got dropped, we might still hit policy gates.

carla-release: good. let's do pin+promote for staging canary now, block prod. we'll schedule republish with correct manifest+attestation in the 02:30 UTC window. assign tasks: ben -> create pinned tag and run canary smoke, alia -> coordinate with infra for KMS/quarantine fix and republish, dave -> approve manual promote and be oncall at 02:30, emily -> update release notes and communication. I'll own the block label and doc.

alia.dev: noted. infra, ticket incoming: need temporary removal of kms:quarantine enforcement for backend staging republish, or a signed reupload route. pinging @infra-team.

deploy-bot: action required: manual-approve:retag-and-publish. /approve by infra or SRE will clear hold.

dave-sre: I'll be available 02:00-03:30 UTC. can approve manual promote and validate arm64 nodes after republish.

emily-rm: release note blurb draft: "Staging publish for redwood/backend:staging-20260320 was pinned to a previous digest due to a multi-arch provenance mismatch affecting linux/arm64. A republish with corrected attestation is scheduled for 02:30 UTC; prod promotion remains blocked until post-republish verification."

ben.eng: running the pin now and will post results.

ben.eng: pinned tag created: backend:staging-20260320-pin -> sha256:9a1b... hooking canary traffic back to pinned tag. smoke ok on x86, arm64 still routed to pinned digest and returning 200s.

alia.dev: infra replied: KMS quarantine annotation collision caused by parallel signing job. infra will coordinate a single re-sign job during the 02:30 window to avoid race.

carla-release: thanks all. labeling this thread release-blocker and leaving prod promotion blocked until post-window verification. will follow up with release notes update and a short incident summary after resolution. :thumbsup:
